notes.title: Annie: Last Hope – Re-release & Update Notes
notes.content:
Following a round of optimization and adjustments, Annie: Last Hope will soon be available for purchase again. The latest update includes the following improvements:
[olist]
Added Japanese language support

New aiming guide feature, which can be enabled in the game settings

Performance optimizations, including reduced memory usage and improved frame rates
[/olist]
We sincerely thank all players who have supported Annie: Last Hope. We will continue to update and improve the game to bring you an even better gameplay experience.
